text:
sasha: heads-up, AP NOC just alerted on a regional network blip that caused a control-plane retry spike. observability shows elevated 5xx to canary traffic.

deploybot: Deploybot: Canary rollout paused (slot 42). Reason: external_network_errors > 3% over 5m. See /deploy status #canary-42.

ops-oncall: confirmed, seeing short DB connection churn in ap-southeast-2. Not a full outage but enough to push latencies.

michael: ok — recommend we gate the upcoming release window for AP and not push to global. Suggest deferring AP zone until we have 30m stable.

lara: agreed. What's the impact on the downstream job that depends on this release? release-manager, quick check?

release-manager: downstream job is non-critical for AP ramp, we can decouple. I'll pin the version for EU/NA and hold AP. Plan: partial rollout -> pin v2.14.3 in EU/NA, hold AP.

sasha: +1. Can someone update the release notes and the orchestration flags so the deploybot doesn't retry AP?

release-manager: doing now. Patch to change rollout policy:
```
rollout: {
  regions: [eu, na],
  hold_regions: [ap-southeast-2]
}
```
I'll push the pinned version and add a note in release notes.

michael: also adding a soft-rollback plan if errors persist after re-run: rollback-to: v2.14.2, notify @ops-oncall, start canary at 2% for 10m.

ops-oncall: 👍 setting alert runbook: if 5xx > 2% for 10m, escalate to infra and flip routing to standby control plane.

deploybot: Deploybot: Updated rollout policy applied. Canary slot 42 remains paused. New rollout: eu/na only.

lara: Sasha, can you file a short blameless note in incident channel linking timeline and deploy decision? Ops will need it for postmortem.

sasha: on it, posting to #incidents in 2m. I'll include timestamps and the pinned release artifact hash.

release-manager: release notes diff: "AP region deferred due to transient network errors; EU/NA release active. AP deployment postponed pending network stability. Version pinned for partial rollout: v2.14.3 (sha256:abc123)."

michael: one more ask — add a console banner for AP customers so support gets fewer tickets. Small message: "We are temporarily deferring a minor update in AP region to improve stability; ETA 30–60 minutes."

release-manager: banner posted.

ops-oncall: monitoring — spikes receded 3m ago but still jittery. Holding 30m window and will re-evaluate at +30.

sasha: thanks all. If AP looks stable at +30, we can resume canary at 1% and follow the soft-rollback threshold. If not, we'll shift the slot to tomorrow morning AP maintenance window.

deploybot: Deploybot: Thread note appended: "hold applied by release-manager; contingency=soft-rollback; next-check=1745014145"

michael: cheers. I'll stand by and help with rollback if needed.

lara: :thumbsup: documented and coordinated.

sasha: thread closed for now — will repost update after the +30 check."
